summary: AI agent server core: tools, turns, quota, and a mock-ready provider contract
description:
Gives a jPulse site an AI agent by configuration rather than by building one. A site registers scope and tools through hooks; the plugin runs turns, enforces authorization and quota, and streams replies over HTTP.

  • Tools layer: named capabilities, four authorization gates, declarative per-turn budgets
  • Agent layer: turn loop, provider contract, prompt assembly, reserve-then-settle quota
  • HTTP/SSE: complete turns over plain HTTP for controller-centric sites

Installs together with ai-mock as @jpulse-net/plugin-ai. A commercial provider is a separate package.
author: jPulse Team <team@jpulse.net>
